_comment: Example settings.json. The real file lives at %AppData%\InternetMonitor\settings.json and is never checked into source control. Copy the shape below as a starting point.
_comment_endpoints: Application endpoints are entirely user-defined - nothing here is required by the application itself. The two examples below show how an organization would add its own APIs; delete them if you don't need them.
_comment_logging: Diagnostic logging is off by default. Levels: Off, Basic, Extended, Full.
_comment_kuma: Uptime Kuma push heartbeat is off by default (KumaPushUrl empty). Paste your own push-monitor URL to activate it; minimum interval is 60 seconds.
